Controlled split: Sportsbet has Warriors $1.57 and Titans $2.42. Gold Coast are at home with attacking momentum while the Warriors replace injured Taine Tuaupiki at fullback.
Protect pick: Sportsbet has Panthers $1.35. Dylan Edwards is still out, but Jack Cogger returns alongside Nathan Cleary, Liam Martin and Isaah Yeo.
Market match: Sportsbet has Broncos $1.50. Ponga and Gagai return for Newcastle, but Dylan Brown and Dylan Lucas are season-ending outs.
Protect pick: Sportsbet has Sharks $1.27. Cronulla are flying after a 48-12 win and regain Tom Hazelton.
Market match: Sportsbet has Eels $1.41. Tigers regain Doueihi but remain unsettled; Parramatta get Junior Paulo back via the bench.
